crossRefs.note: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

parallels.note: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.

people.name: Arpachshad
people.line: Son of Shem, ancestor of Abraham

people.name: Shelah
people.line: Son of Arpachshad and ancestor of Abraham

translations.web: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.
translations.bsb: When Arphaxad was 35 years old, he became the father of Shelah.
translations.kjv: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:
translations.asv: And Arpachshad lived five and thirty years, and begat Shelah.
